newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Explosion at Albanian weapons depot kills 22.
newsitem.headline: Explosion at Albanian weapons depot kills 22.

text.p: An explosion at a weapons depot in the central Albanian town of Burrel killed 22 people on Wednesday, a government spokesman said.
Ammunition and weapons are stored underground in many Albanian military depots.
The spokesman did not know the cause of the blast but said that the explosion occurred in a mining area.
"I do confirm that there are 22 people dead in the explosion in the mining area," he told Reuters.
No further details were immediately available.
